messages.content: The airline moved our Monday Pittsburgh return from 4:55 to 7:42 p.m. Compare that with switching to an earlier flight. I don’t want to spend money unless it meaningfully improves the day.

The new 7:42 p.m. departure arrives at ORD at 8:25 p.m. and requires no payment. There is a 2:10 p.m. PIT-ORD flight arriving at 2:53 p.m.; the change is $234 total in standard economy or $378 total in business after applying the value of the existing return segments. Both have seats for three. A 12:35 p.m. PIT-MDW option is $ ninety-six less than the ORD flight, but it would require different transportation home and only has seats across separate rows.
Lead with business when it’s available and workable. Would the three of us be in the same area on the 2:10?

Yes. Business has 3A, 3C, and 3D available, placing all three of you in row 3, with one pair together and the third seat directly across the aisle. Standard economy can place all three together in row 14.
How does that earlier departure work with checkout and our bags?

Schenley House reconfirmed that checkout is at 11:00 a.m. and it will hold your luggage at no charge afterward. Allowing 30-40 minutes to PIT plus time for bag check and security, you should retrieve the bags and leave the hotel around 11:45 a.m. The later flight would mean storing them until about 4:45 p.m. and reaching home roughly five and a half hours later.
So the business change is $378 for all three, not per person, and there’s no issue with the Saturday game or Sunday museum?
Correct: $378 total for all three travelers. The outbound flight, hotel stay, Saturday game, and Sunday museum plan are unchanged. Only Monday’s return moves earlier.
That improves Monday enough. Change us to the 2:10 business flight and take those row 3 seats. Leave the rides unbooked.

Updated under confirmation P6T8RM: Monday PIT-ORD now departs at 2:10 p.m. and arrives at 2:53 p.m. in business, with seats 3A, 3C, and 3D assigned. The original return value was applied, $378 was charged, and no residual fare credit remains. Schenley House will hold the luggage after 11:00 a.m. checkout; plan to leave around 11:45 a.m. All rides remain unbooked and unpaid. The revised charged trip total is $2,171.46, or an expected $2,381.46 including the unchanged $210 ride estimate, before meals and admissions.
